visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Full-page capture at 390 CSS px (deviceScaleFactor 1) clipped per region and compared with the same CSS-px region of the scale-1 Pencil PNG, pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2). Regions: vARtQ:identity (frame y 48-120, aligned on the avatar top) and vARtQ:level (frame y 212-290, aligned on the level card top). Structural probes (order, avatar 72px, gutters, 1px hairline, >=60px rows, 44px targets, no overflow, journey vertical geometry) assert exactly.

perScreenRationale.vARtQ:identity: Observed residual 0.1770 on the avatar-aligned 390x72 region; 0.20 leaves 0.023 for cross-renderer variance. Intentional adaptation, not a layout defect: the frame's 'Right side · Madrid · since 2024' single-line meta versus the real side and the localized full member-since date (wraps to two lines at 390px), the 44px edit control the frame does not draw (Edit profile behavior is preserved), and initials versus the frame's sample initials. Avatar size/colour token, name weight and order are exact structural probes.
perScreenRationale.vARtQ:level: Observed residual 0.0872 on the level-card-aligned 390x78 region; 0.11 leaves 0.023 for cross-renderer variance. Residual is the frame's sample figures (3.82, '76% reliable', green season delta) versus the real level, 'Reliability: N%' and no season delta (no source, D6). Card radius token, hairline and gutters are exact structural probes.
